Subject: Quarterly prep: Portfolio health, renewal risk register & exec flags

Team / Sara —

I pulled together the initial renewal register for Acme and a short portfolio health snapshot. Goal: surface items that need exec attention before the Q4 review so the GTM and Product execs can sign off.

Quick asks:
- Grace/Jordan: please add 1-2 line status & risk for your owners in the attached register by EOD Tuesday (10/20). Highlight any items that need an exec call or SLA/credits ask.
- Mina: can you add the most recent usage trend and billing delta to the health snapshot?
- Sara: if procurement has a firm timeline for PO/terms, drop that in reply — we want to map to renewal lanes.

Attachments: [Attachment: 2026-10-18_renewal_register_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

On Sun, Oct 18, 2026 at 09:12 AM Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team / Sara —
> 
> I pulled together the initial renewal register for Acme and a short portfolio health snapshot. Goal: surface items that need exec attention before the Q4 review so the GTM and Product execs can sign off.

Thanks Alex — I updated the register with a short status and risk column for the engineering-surface items. High level notes (added to row-level comments):

- Ingestion throughput regression (ROW 4): Severity = Medium. Cause: customers hitting a new protobuf path on Beta. Mitigation: rolling patch next week; SLA risk if not deployed by 10/28. Owner: Engineering (S. Patel).
- KV cache growth (ROW 7): Severity = Low. Observed during peak testing; recommend short-term increase in cache quota for Acme; cost impact ~2.4% token spend. Owner: Ops (M. Chen).
- Model variant mismatch (ROW 12): Severity = High. Customer using older embeddings which are regressing similarity. Needs PR for model pin + fallback policy before contract signature. Owner: Product (R. Malhotra).

Attached a one-pager health snapshot with recent usage trends and anomaly callouts.

Attachments: [Attachment: ACME_health_snapshot_20261019.pdf (pdf)]

I'll also drop the key charts into the Drive slide deck.

Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@acme.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19 14:21 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly prep: Portfolio health, renewal risk register & exec flags

Thanks for the summary — and thanks Grace for the snapshot. A couple quick notes from procurement:

- We are targeting a PO by 11/15 but need final terms signed by 11/01 to make internal cycle.
- There is an open question on data residency language for one of our EU subsidiaries — procurement is looping legal separately.

Happy to do a 20-minute sync with your team to walk any flagged items. I'm available Friday 10/22 between 9:30–12:00 PT.

Sara Holt
Director, Cloud Platform | Acme Corp
sara.holt@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Holt <sara.holt@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-20 09:37 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly prep: Portfolio health, renewal risk register & exec flags

Alex / team — compiling a short exec slate here based on the register & Grace's snapshot. I pushed the summary into the Drive deck (slide 3) and called out owners. Copying the key exec asks below so leadership has a one-screen view.

Exec attention items (priority order):
1) Model pin & compatibility (High) — Impact: potential accuracy regressions during onboarding, could stall renewal sign-off.
   - Owner: Jordan Blake / Product (coordinate with R. Malhotra)
   - Ask: Product to approve a pin + fallback policy and sign-off by 10/27.
2) SLA exposure for throughput regression (Medium) — Impact: latency spikes under peak could trigger credit requests.
   - Owner: Grace O'Connor / Engineering S. Patel
   - Ask: Engineering to confirm patch schedule and fallback routing by 10/25; if missed, leadership to approve temporary capacity burst.
3) Procurement timeline alignment (Admin) — Impact: legal/PO timing.
   - Owner: Alex Martinez / CS (Grace) + Acme procurement
   - Ask: Confirm final terms by 11/01 and PO by 11/15.
4) Data residency variance for EU subsidiary (High) — Impact: legal hold on certain accounts.
   - Owner: Mina Haddad / Security & Legal (need to coordinate)
   - Ask: Provide recommended language or escalation path; deadline 10/30 for executive decision.

Action log (quick):
- Alex: Assemble exec slide + deck (done, pushed to Drive).
- Grace: Finalize engineering comment block by 10/20 EOD (in progress).
- Mina: Draft data residency options and cost delta by 10/23.
- Jordan: Draft the short product pin policy and sign-off checklist by 10/27.

I'll move the top-line slide to the leadership folder once the items above are updated. Assuming we hit the internal deadlines, propose we present this in the leadership prep meeting on 10/29.

Jordan Blake
Director, GTM Strategy | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
